# Design brief: <title>

## Problem and evidence

What problem is being solved? What observation, incident, metric or requirement shows it is real?

## Constraints and non-goals

What must hold? What is explicitly out of scope? Which constraints are hard and which are tradeable?

## Options considered

Include at least the chosen option, one credible alternative, and "do nothing smaller". For each,
give the cost, risk and reversibility.

## Decision criteria

What makes one option better? State priorities explicitly, especially when criteria conflict.

## Chosen option and why

What is the decision? Why this option against the criteria and alternatives?

## Assumptions and falsifiers

What must be true? What observation or test would prove the design wrong?

## Reversibility and rollout

How is this deployed? How is it rolled back? What data or API compatibility is affected?

## Success and failure signals

Which metrics, tests or incidents will show that the design is working or failing?
